t: You're looking at Hackney Empire on Mare Street, which The Guardian has called the most beautiful theatre in London. Frank Matcham designed it, and it was built in 1901 as a music hall. It was expanded in 2001, and in 2021 the singer Leona Lewis became its patron. Matcham was a prolific theatre architect, responsible for over ninety theatres in his career, and this is among the most admired of them.
